description: This file defines singleton pattern implementations within the Thunder::Core namespace, including singleton management classes, template specializations, and proxy support.

classes.name: Singleton
classes.description: Base class implementing singleton management, including registration and disposal of singleton instances.

classes.name: SingletonType
classes.description: Template class deriving from Singleton, providing singleton instance management with thread safety and optional parameterized construction.

classes.name: SingletonProxyType
classes.description: Template class providing singleton proxy support, wrapping a proxy type with singleton semantics.

classes.name: UniqueType
classes.description: Template class implementing a reference-counted singleton with thread safety.

methods.name: ImplementationName
methods.description: Pure virtual method to return the implementation name of the singleton.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance, with overloads for parameterized and default construction.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates the singleton instance with optional parameters, intended for controlled lifetime management.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the singleton instance, ensuring proper cleanup.

methods.name: Drop
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes singleton if no longer referenced.
